counting_unit: Three actual logical inventory lake features; not a count of newly approved scalar names.
selection_count_note: All three records are new actual-inventory investigations; no historical verdict or exact-ID lead is restored.

records.supported_name_scope: The complete generalized north-south ring agrees with the mapped Montreal waterbody: broad rounded north, middle westward shoulder, east-bank narrowing and pointed long southern arm. The small northern inlet and finer shore indentations differ; nearby separate waters are not absorbed.
limits: One WSA thematic cartographic publication supports this assessment; separate map regions are not independent sources.
The map is dated 2014-11-25 at 1:1,750,000; a 2025 URL and later HTTP metadata do not update it.

The historical review considered complete source and baseline shapes at regional thematic scale. No survey control, quantitative shoreline fit, formal registry status or current naming act was verified.
